lines.text: Hi! Can we move Maya's Tuesday session? Soccer ran late.
Sure! Wednesday at 4? Or Thursday at 5?
Wednesday's piano... Thursday works! Wait, this Thursday or next Thursday?
Nine texts later... here's the fix. The bot sends parents the open slots, they tap one, and everyone gets the update.
This is your FlowPilot speaking. Comment SCHEDULE and we'll show you how. You're still the captain.
